spec_text: Foto móvil RGB de monitor multiparamétrico simulado con tira de ECG: ritmo y reflejo leve, WebP RGB.
license: CC0-1.0 (content generated by project code; no third-party material)
expected_system_behavior: VALID_NON_INTERFERENCE; clinical support only, no autonomous exclusion of urgent pathology
subgroup_note: MST specification is not an adjudicated Fitzpatrick phototype; never infer age or phototype from pixels.

review_controls.known_limitations: Monitor strip is a flat render with a gradient reflection; no multiparametric monitor chrome.

realism_review_360x640.required: clinical realism >= 4/5 from EACH of 2 independent reviewers, unambiguous true modality, agreed pair difficulty

review_controls.validity_justification: Stage 1 measures usage errors (modality selection, confirmation, false cancellation, comprehension of technical abstentions), not diagnostic performance. For the legitimate-negative controls (scenario F) the stimulus only has to be recognizable as its true modality and technically valid (RGB photo, no DICOM) so that the pipeline must NOT block it. A schematic is a candidate for that narrow role only; it is NOT assumed valid until two independent reviewers rate realism >= 4/5 and the owner signs.
